entry.title: Hunter Schafer Breaks Down 18 Looks, From The Hunger Games to Euphoria | Life in Looks | Vogue

media:group.media:title: Hunter Schafer Breaks Down 18 Looks, From The Hunger Games to Euphoria | Life in Looks | Vogue
media:group.media:description:
Blade Runner 2099 star Hunter Schafer takes a trip down memory lane and rifles through some of her most memorable fashion moments. Starting with her early days as a runway model, Hunter reminisces about opening the R13 show when she was just 18 years old, before going on to walk in 18 shows the following year. She then turns the page to her head-turning collaboration with the one-and-only Law Roach at the Vanity Fair Oscar Party, as well as the stained-glass Schiaparelli dress she wore to the Hunger Games premiere.

entry.title: Jennifer Lawrence Gets Ready for the Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Premiere | Vogue

media:group.media:title: Jennifer Lawrence Gets Ready for the Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Premiere | Vogue
media:group.media:description:
Watch as Jennifer Lawrence gets ready for the premiere of the newest film in the Hunger Games franchise, Sunrise on the Reaping. Fourteen years after the first film hit theaters, Jennifer reflects on the series that forever changed her life. She talks about her excitement to reunite with Josh Hutcherson and members of the film crew, many of whom have been with the franchise since the beginning. Jennifer also explains why she’s no longer excited by Hollywood after-parties and would rather spend a cozy night in watching Dateline. She also shares her current beauty routine and some of the trends she’s tried over the years, including her essential mes° beauty haircare products.

entry.title: Sienna Miller’s 27-Step New Mom Beauty Routine | Beauty Secrets | Vogue

media:group.media:title: Sienna Miller’s 27-Step New Mom Beauty Routine | Beauty Secrets | Vogue
media:group.media:description:
“Madden” star Sienna Miller takes us through her everyday beauty routine while dealing with a bothersome black eye (the result of a 3 a.m. breastfeeding incident). As she works through her full beauty look, Sienna talks about playing Roger Ailes’s wife in full prosthetics, her daughter’s brief but alarming Sephora phase, and the three star tattoos she got years ago that later turned out to be prophetic. She finishes by drinking her vitamin C supplement straight from the glass and delivers a direct message to famed filmmaker Paul Thomas Anderson.
